text:
marie (finance): Heads-up: we're rolling out two billing changes on 2026-05-01. Short thread with details and links.

alec (revops): TL;DR: 1) invoice line-item clarity (separate row for free-credit usage vs billable tokens). 2) free trial credits will phase from 90d to 60d for new signups. No price changes.

jonah (sales): Will this affect customers currently on trial?

marie (finance): Existing trials are grandfathered for 30 days after rollout. New signups after 2026-05-01 get 60d. We're announcing to customers next week.

jonah (sales): OK. Can we get a one-pager for customer-facing comms?

alec (revops): Yes, draft being reviewed by legal. Ping me if you need region-specific wording.

marie (finance): Important detail on invoices: free-credit consumption will now appear as a separate line item called `Free credit usage` with negative value in the pre-tax section, followed by `Net billable tokens`. This should make reconciliation easier.

sara (eng): Any changes on rate-limits or soft caps tied to the free credits?

alec (revops): No hard rate-limit changes. We are introducing a soft burst cushion for API keys on the free tier: short bursts allowed up to current limits, but sustained usage beyond quota will trigger a gentle 429 with `Retry-After`. See snippet:```json
{
  "status": 429,
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```

sara (eng): Got it. Will add handling notes to SDKs and error pages.

billing-bot: Invoice preview for 2026-05 sent to finance@redwood.internal (auto).

marie (finance): Quick example of new invoice section (simplified):
```
Invoice #INV-2026-0245
Date: 2026-05-03
---
Free credit usage: -$35.00
Net billable tokens: $120.50
Tax: $9.03
Total due: $94.53
```

jonah (sales): Nice — separates out promo consumption. Will help AE conversations.

alec (revops): Ops note: billing export schema will add `free_credit_amount` and `free_credit_period_end` fields. Data team, please subscribe to the new webhook topic `billing.invoice.v2`.

sara (eng): We'll add webhook consumer and flag in staging by 2026-04-20.

marie (finance): Communication plan: customer email (next Wed), in-console banner (48h pre-change), changelog post, and updated docs <https://internal.redwood/docs/billing/credits-and-invoices>.

jonah (sales): Can CS get the FAQ doc?

alec (revops): Uploading the FAQ now: <https://internal.redwood/handbooks/billing/faq-2026-05>. Please review.

marie (finance): If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll ship the announcement. @jonah @sara @alec please thumbs-up here when you've reviewed. :thumbsup:

jonah (sales): :thumbsup:
